fields.title: International Consultant – Laboratory Medicine e-Learning Course Author (home-based)
fields.body: WHO seeks an international consultant (Subject Matter Expert) to author an e-learning course on molecular diagnostics and laboratory quality for the WHO Academy. Home-based, remote. Duration: 60 working days over 6 months. Remuneration: USD 500 per day. Open to all nationalities. Advanced university degree in laboratory medicine or biomedical science; at least 10 years experience. English required.

fields.title: National Consultant – Health Training Coordinator
fields.body: National consultant, open to Kenyan nationals only. Duty station Nairobi, on-site only. Training coordination.
